sloka: तस्य यानम् च दासीः च सौमित्रे सम्प्रदापय ।कौशेयानि च वस्त्राणि यावत् तुष्यति स द्विजः ॥२-३२-१६॥
transliteration: tasya yānam ca dāsīḥ ca saumitre sampradāpaya ।kauśeyāni ca vastrāṇi yāvat tuṣyati sa dvijaḥ ॥2-32-16॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, give away chariots, maidservants, silk clothes to learned brahmins of Taittiriya branch and wellversed in the Vedas, to agreeable and faithful brahmins attending on Kausalya with their blessings till they are fully satisfied.
